req-01.summary: Remove array-to-record predicates from both throwable classifiers
req-01.fix: Delete both ad-hoc isRecord predicates. Narrow with P.isObject before record reads, retaining correctly inferred record types and normal-object classification. Add array and ordinary-object regressions to both classifier suites; send law-17-forced array exclusion to central deviation recording. Do not restore the oracle casts.

req-02.summary: Make blocking installation-token refresh interruptible without losing ownership
req-02.fix: Retain serialization and atomic ownership transfer, but mask only ownership state updates/finalizer registration. Restore interruption around blocking revoke/sign/mint work and retain or finalize any acquired replacement before interruption can discard it. Add a blocked-refresh regression in GitHubApp.test.ts proving HTTP abort, requesting-fiber termination and correct token cleanup.

req-03.fix: Reuse existing pagination machinery to traverse cursor pages and decode collected entries through the owned schema. Preserve API-version headers, predicate filter, order and existing notFound/422 empty-result handling. Add a two-page Link/cursor regression in Attestation.coverage.test.ts; central recording receives the verified upstream-bug evidence.

req-04.summary: Reject invalid numeric HTTP statuses before constructing GitHubError
req-04.fix: Use a schema-derived S.Int guard before retaining a status. Treat invalid statuses as unavailable, classify as transport failure and preserve the original cause. Add non-finite/fractional-status regressions in GitHubError.test.ts and supply the upstream-bug evidence centrally.

req-05.summary: Classify duplicate-resource prose before truncating the displayed reason
req-05.fix: Retain the complete original message for classification with structured validation entries; sanitize only the emitted reason after selecting the error kind. Add a long-message duplicate-resource regression in GitHubError.test.ts and provide upstream-bug evidence for central recording.

The inspected S3 diff adds test files rather than rewriting upstream tests, so no concrete upstream test-line restoration was identified. Do not retain full splitting as a recorded deviation.

req-07.summary: Restore upstream short-circuit comment marker search
req-07.fix: Restore comments.find(comment => marker.matches(comment.body ?? '')) and the selected CommentRecord body fallback existing.body ?? '', preserving upstream short-circuit order. Restore any upstream test lines rewritten for this divergence; the inspected commit identifies none. Add an early-match/body-read regression in GitHubIssue.coverage.test.ts. req-08.summary: Render absent/null content encodings without creating a defect
req-08.fix: Keep the law-forced schema JSON codec, but make rendering total for the rejection path: undefined renders as 'undefined', null as 'null', and strings remain JSON-quoted via a nonthrowing codec. Preserve the typed rejected/422 result and add omitted/null/string encoding regressions in GitHubContent.coverage.test.ts. The faulty change itself is required; recording its forced provenance belongs to the central codemod. Do not restore JSON.stringify.

req-09.fix: Replace these five Effect.succeed(O.none<...>()) expressions with Effect.succeedNone, preserving surrounding catchIf, pagination completion and declared types. Keep existing notFound/completion tests in the owned GitBranch/GitHubCommit/GitHubContent/GitHubRelease coverage suites green; no docs-example sweep is assigned here.

req-10.summary: Use identity for the GraphQL passthrough variable encoder
req-10.fix: Import identity from effect/Function and use encodeVariables ?? identity. Preserve reference identity and both default/custom encoder behavior in GraphQL.coverage.test.ts.

req-11.summary: Bound retry-delay milliseconds to the error schema's integer domain
req-11.fix: Bound both nonnegative millisecond calculations to Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER before returning them, ensuring the computed delay remains in S.Int and oversized values still exceed the retry ceiling. Add unsafe-integer/overflow/reset regressions in internal/headers.coverage.test.ts and a typed HTTP-failure regression in transport.test.ts; provide upstream-bug evidence centrally.

req-12.fix: Protect both coercions with a nonthrowing conversion and stable fallback description; retain the original throwable as cause and preserve descriptions for successful coercions. Add both counterexamples to GraphQL.coverage.test.ts and send verified upstream-bug evidence for central recording.

req-13.fix: Decode projected values effectfully using the owning schemas and map failures to operation-specific GitHubError.decode, following PullRequest.project. Validate comments before marker matching, use effectful traversal for tags, and apply workflow status projection to both direct reads and discovery. Preserve valid defaults/order/results. Add malformed-response typed-channel regressions in PullRequestComment.test.ts, WorkflowDispatch.test.ts and GitTag.test.ts; supply EF-3 deviation details centrally.

req-14.summary: Decode secret, variable, ruleset and workflow list return models
req-14.fix: Decode the selected list fields through VariableInfo, SecretInfo, RulesetInfo and WorkflowInfo before returning, mapping failures to each operation's GitHubError.decode. Preserve ordering, field selection, optional-field representation and plain-object results. Cover repository/environment paths and malformed responses in the owning RepositoryVariable.test.ts, RepositorySecret.test.ts, Ruleset.test.ts and WorkflowDispatch.test.ts.
